# [TASK] Add start-live-demo.sh 1-command script with automated healthcheck and live URL

## Task
Create a master `start-live-demo.sh` script that starts the stack, launches the public HTTPS tunnel, runs health checks against all 7 microservices, and outputs the ready-to-share live portfolio link with zero manual setup.

## Scope
Includes `infrastructure/scripts/start-live-demo.sh`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] 1-command execution: runs infrastructure startup, Cloudflare tunnel, and health verification.
- [x] Displays live URL and service dashboard in clear terminal output.
- [x] Returns non-zero exit code if any core service fails health checks.
